warn.first: This is the FIRST trick. Taking it costs 1 point.
warn.last: This is the LAST trick. Taking it costs 1 point.
warn.queen: The Queen of clubs is on the table: taking this trick costs -1.
warn.queenInHand: You hold the Queen of clubs (whoever takes the trick it is played in loses a point).

hint.slobberhannesAvoid: This trick carries a penalty. Play low and let someone else take it.
hint.slobberhannesDump: A safe trick — get rid of a high card while you can.
hint.slobberhannesLeadLow: Lead low and see what happens.

tutorial.scores: Each seat's score and the penalties it has taken this round. First trick, last trick, and the Q of clubs cost 1 point each; escaping all three scores 1.
tutorial.trick: Cards played this trick appear here. There is no trump — the highest card of the led suit wins.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring; if you hold the led suit you must follow it.
tutorial.actions: After a round ends, continue with Next round. The hint changes its aim depending on whether the trick is dangerous.
